section_summary.extract_value: This section presents Appendix A, which contains the Caregiver Eating Messages Scale (CEMS)—a 10-item questionnaire measuring parental/caregiver eating-related messages during childhood. Items are rated on a 6-point Likert scale (Never to Always), with items 1-4 and 9 comprising the Pressure to Eat Messaging (PEM) subscale and items 5-8 and 10 comprising the Restrictive Control Messaging (RCM) subscale. No study data, sample characteristics, or statistical results are presented in this appendix.
